name: Replica Target Audio
description: Bind explicit reference voices to Final Target Dialogue, synthesize real speech with local IndexTTS-2.5, and measure actual duration from persisted audio.
when_to_use: REPLICA has CURRENT TARGET_SCRIPT and CURRENT TARGET_BIBLE and needs target-language dialogue audio
when_not_to_use: Storyboard or video generation is being requested

steps.title: 校验目标参考声线
steps.description: 校验每条 Final Target Dialogue 都有唯一、显式、可追溯的 IndexTTS reference voice。

steps.title: 生成真实目标对白音频
steps.description: 逐句持久化 ProviderJob 后调用本地 IndexTTS-2.5，保存真实 WAV 并由服务端探测实际语音时长。

fact_levels: Final Target Dialogue is immutable input
Actual speech duration is server-probed media fact
provider_rules: Persist ProviderJob before every synthesis call
Provider cannot choose or rewrite Final Target Dialogue
Do not expose reference audio bytes in ProviderJob payloads
Unknown target_character_id requires explicit utterance-level voice binding
completion_criteria: Every utterance is covered exactly once
Every clip is real persisted decodable media
Every clip has SHA256 and server-probed duration
Candidate is explicitly accepted before CURRENT TARGET_AUDIO publication
failure_policy: IndexTTS or media probe failure keeps previous CURRENT unchanged
